title: Rules
description: A complete description of one solitaire game.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URI for editor validation (ignored by the solver).

auto_flip.description: Turn up a face-down card when it becomes the top of an uncovered pile. Default true.

choose_base.description: Opening choice of the foundation base rank: before a base rank is set, only a single-card move from this group to a foundation is legal, and its rank becomes the base rank.

deal.description: The opening deal, step by step. Cards come off a shuffled pack.

groups.description: The piles on the table, in groups of identical piles.

redeal.description: Gathering the tableau and dealing it out again, as a player action (Cruel, La Belle Lucie, Montana). Can't be combined with `stock`.

removal.description: Card-removal mechanics, for games that discard cards instead of (or as well as) building. One object or a list.

safe_autoplay.description: Let the solver play cards to foundations automatically when it can prove nothing could ever need to be built on them. Sound for in-suit foundations; default true.

score.description: Points for the position, for games played for a score (Poker Squares).

search.description: Tuning for the solver's heuristic. Changes how fast a win is found, never whether a position is judged winnable.

stock.description: How the stock deals. Needs a group of kind `stock`. A stock without these rules only feeds refills (`refill_from`).

Adjacency.description: Which grid positions count as neighbours.

oneOf.description: Horizontally, vertically or diagonally next to each other (Monte Carlo).
Horizontally or vertically next to each other.

Build.description: How cards are built on one another.

blocked_ranks.description: Nothing may be built on cards of these ranks (Golf: kings).

gap_ranks.description: With a stripped pack: ranks that are not adjacent to the pack rank just below them (an ace-and-7-to-king pack: `[7]`). Applies to `step` 1 builds.

wrap.description: The sequence wraps: king to ace and ace to king.

BuildBy.description: The suit or colour relation between a card and the card placed on it.

oneOf.description: Nothing may be built.
Any suit.
Same suit.
Alternate colours.
Same colour.
Any suit but the same one.
The same suit or the same rank (Accordion; pair with `dir: any`).

ChooseBase.description: Rules for choosing the foundation base rank on the opening move.

deal_waste.description: Immediately deal one card from the stock to the waste after the choice.

from.description: Group whose cards may be played to a foundation to choose the base rank.

refill_from_stock.description: Immediately deal one card from the stock to the emptied source pile after the choice.

CribbagePoints.description: Points for each cribbage combination. Defaults are the standard values.

fifteen.description: Each different set of cards adding up to 15 (court cards count 10, aces 1).

flush.description: A full line all of one suit.

flush_starter.description: More when the starter is that suit too.

heels.description: Once, if the starter is a jack ("two for his heels").

nobs.description: For each hand holding the jack of the starter's suit ("one for his nob").

pair.description: Each pair of cards of the same rank.

run_card.description: Each card of each run of three or more ranks in sequence (ace low), counted once per different set of cards making the run.

CribbageRules.description: Cribbage scoring. Each line is a hand; once every pile of the grid holds a card, the starter joins every hand as a fifth card. Fifteens, pairs and runs count in a line of any length; a flush needs a full line of at least four cards.

starter.description: Group whose first pile's top card is the starter, read when the grid is full. Usually the waste: the card turned after the grid is filled. No starter if left out or empty.

DealStep.description:
One step of the opening deal.

Cards come off the shuffled pack in order. With `count` or `counts`, they are dealt in rows: one card to each selected pile, then the next row, as a person would deal them.

auto_foundation.description: During this step, place any dealt card directly on the first foundation that accepts it.

collect.description: After this step, take every card of these ranks off the table and put them on this step's group (Montana: deal all 52, then remove the aces to leave gaps).

counts.description: Cards to each selected pile, per pile.

divert_ranks.description: During this step, divert dealt cards of these ranks to the first foundation that accepts them; with `drain_foundations`, restrict draining to these ranks.

drain_foundations.description: After each dealt row, repeatedly move exposed top cards of the selected piles onto any accepting foundation (restricted to `divert_ranks` if set).

kings_to_bottom.description: After dealing, move each pile's kings to its bottom, keeping their order (Baker's Dozen).

limit.description: With `ranks` (and no `count`): take at most this many matching cards in total instead of all of them.

of_base.description: Take every remaining card of the dealt base rank out of the pack and put one on each selected pile in turn (requires an earlier step with `set_base`).

one_each.description: With `ranks`: take only the first card of each listed rank, in the listed order (Calculation's A, 2, 3, 4).

one_per_suit.description: Pull one card of each suit (in pack suit order) from the deck per round (repeated `count` times, default 1), placing them on the selected piles in turn.

piles.description: Piles of the group to deal to (indices). Default: all.

ranks.description: Take every card of these ranks out of the pack and put one on each selected pile in turn (Beleaguered Castle's aces).

rest.description: Deal every remaining card, round-robin over the selected piles.

set_base.description: The first card this step deals sets the base rank for [`EmptyRule::DealtBase`].

split_on_rank.description: With `rest`: deal sequentially into each selected pile, advancing to the next pile whenever a card of this rank is dealt to a non-empty pile.

Dir.description: Rank direction from a card to the card placed on it.

oneOf.description: Up or down.
Same rank.
Any rank at all (a pile that takes anything, subject to `by`).
Any strictly higher rank in the pack's rank sequence (no wrap).
Nothing.
Any card (or any movable unit).
Only a card of this rank (13 for "kings only").
Only a card whose rank is in this list (e.g. `[1, 13]` for Ace or King).
Only a card of the rank turned up by the deal (Canfield). See [`DealStep::set_base`].

Only the card this many places after the rank turned up by the deal, going round the pack's ranks: `-1` is the rank below the base (Penguin's columns, which take the card that would sit under the foundations' base). See [`DealStep::set_base`].
In a grid: a card that could be built (by this pile's build rule) on the top card of the pile to the left; in the first column, a card of rank `first` (Montana's gaps).
In a grid: like [`EmptyRule::AfterLeft`], or a card that the top card of the pile to the right (if any) could be built on.
A card whose rank is `offset` places after the top card of the pile at the same index in `group`, wrapping around the pack's rank sequence.

accept_only_when_empty.description: Accept cards only when the destination pile is empty (even if `build` is set for moving runs).

accept_when_stock_empty.description: Accept cards only when the stock pile is empty.

accepts_from.description: Only cards coming from these groups are accepted (default: any group).

build.description: What may be placed on a pile's top card. Default: foundations build up in suit; every other kind accepts nothing on a non-empty pile.

color.description: Piles accept only cards of this colour.

compact.description: Keep the group packed: whenever a pile empties, the piles after it slide forward.

compact_face_up.description: When a pile in this group becomes empty, shift the movable face-up run from the next pile into it, leaving any face-down cards behind.

complete_runs.description: Foundation only accepts a whole suit sequence at once, moved together (Spider).

empty.description: What an empty pile accepts. Default: foundations take the pack's first rank; tableaux and cells take any card; reserves, stock and waste take none.

empty_accepts_from.description: Only cards coming from these groups are accepted onto an empty pile (default: same as `accepts_from`).

empty_max_accept.description: Most cards that may be placed onto an empty pile in one move. Default: same as `max_accept`.

empty_suit.description: Empty piles accept only cards of this suit (non-empty piles follow `build` as usual).

final_from_same_index.description: When a pile is one card shy of `max_cards`, its final card must come from the pile at the same index within this group (overriding `accepts_from`).

flip_only_last.description: Only automatically turn a pile's face-down top card face up when it is the sole card left in the pile.

layout.description: For piles that overlap (Pyramid, TriPeaks): which piles cover which.

lock_build_dir.description: When `build.dir` is `either`, the first two-card pile in this group locks the build direction (up or down) for every pile in the group.

freeze_when_built.description: A pile holding `max_cards` cards that all follow its build rule is closed: no card may be moved from it.

lock_pile_dir.description: When `build.dir` is `either`, each pile locks its own build direction (up or down) once it holds two cards.

match_longest_rank.description: A pile with fewer cards than the longest pile in this group only accepts a card whose rank matches the card at the same index in the longest pile.

max_accept.description: Most cards the pile accepts in one move. Default: 1 for foundations (a whole suit for `complete_runs`), unlimited otherwise.

max_cards.description: Most cards the pile may hold. Default: 1 for cells, unlimited otherwise.

max_same_rank.description: Most consecutive face-up cards of the same rank allowed at the top of a pile.

min_cards.description: Fewest cards that must remain on the pile (cards at or below this depth cannot leave).

moves.description: Which cards may leave a pile. Default: one card for tableaux, cells, reserves and the waste; none for foundations and the stock.

moves_when_any_empty.description: Cards may leave piles of this group only once at least one pile in the named group is empty.

moves_when_same_index_empty.description: Cards may leave pile `i` of this group only once pile `i` of the named group is empty.

moves_when_stock_empty.description: Cards may leave piles of this group only once the stock pile is empty.

name.description: Name used in deal steps, solutions and states, e.g. "tableau".

no_build_single_while_stock.description: While the stock is non-empty, forbid building onto a single-card pile in this group and forbid moving a card from a single-card pile in this group onto another non-empty pile of this group.

no_flip.description: Never automatically turn face-down cards in this group face up (cards may still be drawn face up by `refill_from`).

non_empty_max_accept.description: Maximum cards accepted in a single move onto a non-empty pile of this group. Defaults to `max_accept`.

piles.description: Different rules for particular piles of the group (Calculation's foundations, each building by a different step from a different base).

rank_sequence.description: Fixed sequence of ranks required at each pile depth (index 0 for the bottom card, index 1 for the second, etc.). Replaces the rank check of `empty` and `build.dir`; `build.by`, `suit`, `empty_suit`, `color`, and `max_cards` still apply.

reach.description: A pile accepts cards only from piles of its own group exactly this many places after it (Accordion: 1 and 3).

reach_both_ways.description: With `reach`: also accept from piles this many places before the destination pile.

refill_count.description: Cards moved per automatic refill from `refill_from` (default 1).

refill_first_face_down.description: When refilling an emptied pile from the stock with `refill_count > 1`, deal the first card face down unless it is the last card in the stock, and the remaining cards face up.

refill_from.description: When a pile in this group empties, refill it automatically with the top card of the first non-empty pile of these groups, tried in order (Canfield's tableau from its reserve; many games from the waste, then the stock). Stock cards are turned face up. Groups to try in order; a group name or a list.

refill_largest.description: When refilling from a multi-pile group in `refill_from`, take from the pile with the most cards (ties broken by lowest index) rather than the first non-empty pile.

refill_nearest.description: When refilling an emptied pile from `refill_from`, take from the pile at index `i % m` within the source group (where `m` is the source group's size), falling back to the nearest non-empty pile (`+1`, `-1`, `+2`, `-2`, ...).

refill_on_empty.description: Refill a pile in this group only when a move just emptied it, rather than also filling pre-existing empty piles when a refill source later receives a card.

refill_same_index.description: When refilling an emptied pile from `refill_from`, take from the pile at the same index within the source group rather than the first non-empty pile.

replace_on_drop.description: When a card is placed on a non-empty pile of this group, first move the destination pile's existing cards to this group's first pile.

require_valid_base.description: Only allow building onto a non-empty pile if its bottom card satisfies the pile's `empty` rule.

requires_prev_non_empty.description: Each pile after the first may only be started (while empty) once the previous pile in the group is non-empty.

requires_rank_on_prev.description: Each pile after the first only accepts a card whose rank is already present on the previous pile in the group (when empty, it must match the previous pile's bottom card).

suit.description: Piles accept only cards of this suit.

supermove_complete_run.description: With `moves: supermove`, also allow moving a complete suit-length built run regardless of empty cells and columns.

swap_bases.description: When set, moving from one pile of this group onto another may swap the two piles instead of building.

unique_suits.description: No two non-empty piles in this group may share the same suit on their bottom card.

unrestricted_from.description: Cards coming from these groups are accepted onto empty or non-empty piles without checking `build` or `empty` rules (capacity limits still apply).

wild.description: Jokers are wild on these piles: a joker stands for any card that would be legal where it lies. It may be placed wherever some card could be (by the build rule, or the empty rule on an empty pile), and a card may be built on it if it could be built on some card the joker could stand for, given the cards beneath it. The joker's stand-in is never fixed: it is whatever keeps the pile legal. Where jokers aren't wild, a joker can only go to an empty pile that takes any card, and nothing is built on it. Default: wild everywhere but foundations.

Hands.description:
How a hand (the cards in one row or column) scores.

A joker in a hand counts as whichever card scores that hand best. Each hand is valued on its own, so a joker shared by a row and a column (or a joker starter) may stand for different cards in each.

oneOf.description: As a poker hand: its best five-card poker combination. Straights and flushes need five cards; pairs and sets count in a line of any length.
As a cribbage hand, together with a shared starter card (Cribbage Squares).

Layout.description: Overlapping piles: a pile is playable only once every pile covering it is empty.

oneOf.description: A triangle with `rows` rows (row r has r + 1 piles); each pile is covered by the two below it. Group count must be rows × (rows + 1) / 2.
Three peaks of 3 rows each over a base row of 10 (28 piles).
Explicit: `covered_by[i]` lists the piles (indices within the group) covering pile i.
Rows of `columns` piles, read left to right (gap games: Montana). Nothing covers anything; the layout gives each pile a left neighbour.

MoveUnit.description: Which cards may leave a pile together.

oneOf.description: No card may leave.
The top card only.
Any built sequence (by this group's build rule) from the top.
Any built sequence from the top whose cards are all one suit (Spider).
Any run of one suit whose ranks are consecutive, from the top (for piles that build more loosely than they move).
Any number of face-up cards from the top, built or not (Yukon).
A built sequence, as long as free cells and empty piles would allow moving it one card at a time (FreeCell's "supermove"): (empty cells + 1) × 2^(empty piles).
Only the whole pile, all face up.
Either the top card alone, or the whole pile when all face up and built in sequence.
Any built sequence from the top whose cards alternate in colour.
Any built sequence from the top whose cards are all one colour.

copies.description: Copies of each (suit, rank) card. Two-pack games use 2; one-suit Spider uses 8.

jokers.description: Jokers in play, in all (not per copy). Jokers are wild: see [`GroupRules::wild`], [`RemovalKind`] and [`Hands`] for what they stand for where.

ranks.description: Ranks in use, in sequence order: building goes from each rank to the next one in this list. Default `[1..=13]` (ace low). Aces high is `[2, 3, …, 13, 1]`; a stripped pack leaves ranks out.

suits.description: Suits in use. Default: all four.

PileKind.description: What a group of piles is for. The kind sets defaults and tells the solver how to treat it.

oneOf.description: Main playing piles.
Where cards are built to win (or discarded to, in removal games).
Free cells: hold one card each by default.
Cards that may be played from but not onto.
The face-down stock. At most one pile.
Where the stock deals to. At most one pile.

PileOverride.description: Rules for some piles of a group that differ from the group's. Fields left out keep the group's value.

PokerPoints.description: Points per poker hand. A hand counts as its highest-ranking combination (in the usual poker order), whatever the points.

oneOf.description: Pair 2, two pair 5, three of a kind 10, straight 15, flush 20, full house 25, four of a kind 50, straight flush 75, royal flush 100.
Pair 1, two pair 3, three of a kind 6, straight 12, flush 5, full house 10, four of a kind 16, straight or royal flush 30.

PokerTable.description: Points for each poker hand: a named table or explicit points.

RedealHow.description: How a redeal deals the gathered cards.

oneOf.description: Keep the cards in order and deal them back `per_pile` at a time to each pile in turn, starting from the first pile's top cards (Cruel). Fewer piles may end up in use. If there are more cards than `per_pile` for every pile, the surplus is shared out: each pile gets an equal part and the first few one more.
Shuffle the gathered cards, then deal `per_pile` to each pile in turn (La Belle Lucie), sharing out any surplus as for [`RedealHow::Regroup`].
Grid games: leave each row's built sequence in place, shuffle every other card, and deal them back leaving one gap straight after each sequence (Montana).
Close the gaps: slide the cards forward in reading order, then fill the empty places at the end from `refill_from`'s top card, turned face up (Monte Carlo).
Grid games: leave each row's built sequence in place, shuffle every other card, and deal them back leaving the gaps at random positions among the non-sequence slots.
Move each pile's bottom card to its top (Crescent).
Gather piles left-to-right (reversing each pile) and deal all cards back row-by-row.
On redeal `k` (0-indexed), pick up pile `k` and deal its cards one-by-one across the group starting at pile `k` and wrapping around.
Gather all cards of the group, shuffle them, and replay the group's opening deal steps.

RedealRules.description: Gathering a group's cards and dealing them out again.

RemovalKind.description: Jokers are wild in removals: a joker pairs with any card (another joker too) and stands for any one rank of a set. `lower_of_suit` ignores them.

oneOf.description: Remove two playable cards whose ranks add up to `total` (Pyramid: 13), or one card whose rank is listed in `alone` (Pyramid: kings).
Remove a playable card when another playable card is of the same suit and higher in the pack's rank order (Aces Up).
Remove two playable cards of the same rank (Nestor, Simple Pairs).
Remove playable cards whose ranks are exactly this set, together (Elevens' J-Q-K).
Remove two playable cards in the same group whose pile indices differ by one of `distances`, when they match in suit or rank.
Remove `1..=max_len` consecutive non-empty piles in a group when the piles immediately before and after the run match in suit or rank.
Remove `1..=max_len` consecutive non-empty piles in a group when the sum of their ranks is a multiple of `divisor`.

adjacent.description: Cards must be neighbours in their grid (all from one grid group).

from.description: Groups whose playable top cards may be removed.

to.description: Group (its first pile) the removed cards go to.

group.description: A grid group. Each of its rows and each of its columns is scored as a hand.

SearchHints.description: Heuristic weights and search tuning. They change how fast the solver finds a win (or how soon it gives up), never whether a position is judged winnable. Every field has a neutral default.

blocker_weight.description: Cost of a card resting on a card its foundation needs sooner (default 1).

cell_weight.description: Cost of each card in a free cell (default 1).

disorder_weight.description: Cost of each card out of sequence in a building pile, and of each such pile in use (default 1).

fast_share.description: Percent of the budget the default strategy spends on its fast, pruned best-first phase before the sound depth-first search (default 50).

progress_weight.description: Cost of each card still to go home, or each step still missing from the win (default 4).

stock_weight.description: Cost of each card still in a stock that deals to the tableau (default 1).

auto.description: Deal by itself whenever the waste is empty (and the stock isn't).

count.description: Cards per deal (or rounds per deal for multi-pile targets).

count_per_round.description: Cards per deal on each round (0-indexed by redeals used). When non-empty, overrides `count`; rounds past the end reuse the last entry.

deal_empty_first.description: For a multi-pile target: if any target piles are empty, deal only to the empty piles; otherwise deal to every target pile.

deal_per_pile.description: For a multi-pile target with `count > 1`: deal `count` cards to each pile in turn rather than `count` rounds of one card per pile.

divert_ranks.description: When dealing to a multi-pile target, divert cards of these ranks to the first accepting foundation and keep dealing until a non-diverted card lands on the current target pile.

face_up.description: Keep the top card of the stock turned face up so it may be played or removed directly.

final_piles.description: For a multi-pile target: when the remaining stock has at most `final_piles.len()` cards, deal one card to each of these piles of `to` (indices within the group) instead of `piles`.

final_split_to.description: When set, dealing requires at least 2 cards in the stock. If dealing leaves (or starts with) exactly 2 cards in the stock, one card is dealt face up to this group's first pile and the last card remaining in the stock is turned face up.

final_to.description: For a multi-pile target: when the remaining stock has at most as many cards as this group has piles, deal one card to each pile of this group instead of `to`.

first_empty.description: For a multi-pile target: deal `count` cards into the first empty pile instead of one to every pile (Accordion).

only_when_empty.description: Deal only when the target pile is empty: each card must be played before the next is turned (Calculation, Sir Tommy).

piles.description: Specific piles of `to` to deal to (indices within the group). Default: all piles.

piles_per_round.description: Target pile indices within `to` for each round (0-indexed by redeals used). When non-empty, overrides `piles`; rounds past the end reuse the last entry.

redeal_deal_all_alternating.description: On a multi-pile stock redeal, deal all gathered cards back out in rows alternating face-up and face-down (ending face-up), honoring `divert_ranks`.

redeal_reverse.description: When gathering a multi-pile target back into the stock on redeal, gather piles in reverse order.

redeal_shuffle.description: When gathering a multi-pile target back into the stock on redeal, shuffle the gathered cards before dealing them out again.

redeals.description: Times the waste may be turned back into the stock.

require_no_empty.description: The stock may not deal while any pile of the target group is empty (Spider).

require_no_empty_group.description: The stock may not deal while any pile of this named group is empty.

skip_empty.description: For a multi-pile target: deal only to non-empty piles (or to the first pile if all are empty).

to.description: Group the stock deals to. If it is a waste or foundation, `count` cards go onto its first pile. Otherwise (tableau, reserve, cell), `count` rounds of one card go to each pile in turn while cards remain.

unlimited_redeals.description: The waste may be turned back any number of times (overrides `redeals`).

Suit.description: A suit of the French pack.

SwapBases.description: When two piles in the same group may swap their contents on a move from one to the other.

oneOf.description: Swap two single-card piles when each card satisfies the other pile's `empty` rule.
Swap two non-empty piles with different `empty` rules when their bottom cards differ in rank and at least one bottom card satisfies the other pile's `empty` rule.
Every card is on a foundation.
These groups are empty (Pyramid, Golf, TriPeaks: the tableau).
A group holds at least this many cards (Aces Up: 48 discarded).
A group holds at least `cards` cards and every pile of `spread` holds at most one card.
At most this many piles of a group hold cards (Accordion: 1).
Every row of a grid group holds a built sequence from its first column, `length` cards long (default: one less than the row), starting with the rank its first column takes (Montana).
The position scores at least this many points (see [`Rules::score`]).
Every pile in `group` holds `max_cards` cards with a bottom card satisfying its `empty` rule.
Like [`WinRule::Rows`], but checks each row's ordered prefix using `build` instead of the group's build rule.
